name: 18411 · Clarks Summit, PA
findings: ZIP 18411 (Clarks Summit) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18411 (Clarks Summit) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18411 (Clarks Summit) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
